Daily study (risk_management): Kelly-fraction intuition for the 1% risk budget: why deep-fractional Kelly is correct under parameter uncertainty, and how it explains the 2:1 RR floor and the conviction tier - The Kelly criterion f* = W - (1-W)/R maximizes long-run geometric growth (E[log wealth]) and outputs the fraction of capital to RISK - which maps exactly onto this system's 1%-of-equity, entry-to-stop
